method: the 13 programme-level documents published by scripts/publish-programme-artefacts.py were reviewed against their facts packs and the record; each finding names the artefact, the evidence and an executable acceptance

findings.title: no governed_assets action family and no MSP kinds on governed_asset
findings.evidence: SPEC_V2 §8.3 maps mandate/brief/blueprint/business_case/refined_vision/benefits_strategy/benefits_realization_plan/projects_dossier to governed_asset kinds; §10.4 names governed_assets.compose|submit|approve. The served action surface has no governed_assets.* action; governance/assets.rs defines requirements/principles/decisions only; governed_asset kinds in the live copy are adr, charter, closure, postmortem, requirement.
findings.acceptance: an action creates a governed_asset of kind mandate on the programme-definition project, the row reads back, and a test proves the MSP kind set is accepted while an unknown kind is refused

resolved_by.evidence: The governed_assets.compose|get|list|submit|approve family is served (docs/design/data/actions.json); AssetKind carries Mandate/ProgrammeBrief/BusinessCase at crates/domain/src/governance.rs:40-46; governed_assets.rs::a_mandate_is_composed_on_a_project_and_reads_back, ::the_msp_kind_set_is_accepted and ::an_unknown_kind_is_refused_and_writes_nothing prove the DoD at 57780653, an ancestor of the head.

findings.title: programme.shared_config is {} and no action sets it
findings.evidence: psql on the staging copy: coalesce(shared_config::text,'<null>')='{}'; the served action surface has no programmes.* update; safe-art's Shared configuration source is computed from this column and yields no rows.
findings.acceptance: the programme's shared_config carries the keys the programmes share, is read back through an action, and safe-art's Shared configuration section is evidenced

findings.title: inspect-adapt has no kata candidates because no retro lesson exists
findings.evidence: msp.json in the fresh snapshot carries lessons: [] (and demo credits are present); kata_candidate_rows reads msp.lessons meta.kata_candidate; the SAFe inspect-adapt template's Kata candidates section is the only programme-level section still un-evidenced.
findings.acceptance: one retro lesson with a typed meta.kata_candidate is recorded for a cadence and inspect-adapt's Kata candidates section is evidenced

findings.title: programme-risk-register requires Categories and Escalations, which project_register_item does not carry
findings.evidence: information_schema for project_register_item has kind, severity, probability, impact, response, review_at, links, meta and no category or escalation column; the published register states the absence rather than inventing values.
findings.acceptance: the template maps Categories to kind (or retires the heading) and Escalations to meta.escalation, and generate-standards --check is green

findings.title: the product snapshot does not project the action registry
findings.evidence: the live snapshot carries 13 files and no actions.json; the blueprint's Action registry section is sourced from actions.json with projection: live, and is authored as a pointer to the design pack.
findings.acceptance: the product snapshot projects the served action registry and the blueprint section is row-evidenced

findings.title: the product snapshot does not project the licensing frame
findings.evidence: business-case's Licensing frame has no source in the snapshot; the document states the gap; the licences service holds the facts.
findings.acceptance: the licensing frame is projected (or a governed asset carries it) and the business-case section is row-evidenced

findings.title: verify-slices parses SPEC §12 T0-T17, not T18
findings.evidence: scripts/verify-slices.py's extractor matches the T0-T17 rows; T18 (the V2 UI, #559) is absent from the verdict table.
findings.acceptance: T18 is in the harness and its gate executes (or the harness records it as out-of-scope with a named manifest)
